title: Amazon passes Alphabet to become the second largest publicly traded company after Apple – Perfect New Gadgets – Best Gadgets | Best Buy | Perfect Combo
text:
March 21, 2018 Views Earlier this month, we told you that even though it was the third largest company in the world after Apple and Google parent Alphabet, Amazon could be the first company to have a trillion dollar valuation. That’s because over the last year, Amazon’s stock has risen 85% year-over-year while Apple’s shares have grown 24% over the same time period. Extrapolate this trend into the future, and Amazon will be first to one trillion in August with Apple hitting the mark one week later.
